articles.summary: The Wally catalog now lists ten open models, including Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M3 and the DeepSeek V4 family. Fast versions have their own model ids, and Eve answers questions with a probability for each answer.

articles.summary: Education changed my life, and I want every child to have the same tutor a billionaire can buy. That takes intelligence as cheap as water. Here is why we started on-device, why we now host frontier open models through Wally, and where we go next.
